messages:
incident-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT — realtime latency pulse detector triggered for eu-west-1 streaming endpoints. p95 and p99 elevated. alert_id=ALRT-5216789012. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/alerts/ALRT-5216789012

alex_chung: seeing it on the dashboard — p99 ~4.2s (baseline ~0.9s), p95 ~1.2s. spike started ~5m ago.

maria_gomez: paging SRE oncall. @sre_oncall you getting paged? :rotating_light:

sre_oncall: I'm oncall, investigating. pulling traces and recent deploys now. can people drop any recent change links or quick logs? :eyes:

jamie_lee: I pushed a quant canary to a subset of dedicated pools ~6m ago — quant-sparse-v2 on dedicated-pool-5. rolling back if that's the culprit.

sre_oncall: good call. kvcache metrics show a big eviction spike for pool dedicated-pool-5 starting at the same time: https://metrics.redwood/internal/kvcache?pool=dedicated-pool-5&range=15m

leah_h: support: 12 customers in EU reported very slow responses (stalls/long tails) but not 5xx. Opening customer-ops thread for outreach.

maria_gomez: mitigation plan (quick):
1) drain/shift traffic off dedicated-pool-5 in eu-west-1
2) bump prefix/KV cache TTL on impacted pools temporarily
3) if metrics don't recover, rollback quant canary and re-evaluate canary config

sre_oncall: taking step 1 now — updating routing rules to steer traffic away from the canary pool. executing: `rdctl routes update --region eu-west-1 --pool dedicated-pool-5 --weight 0.0 --reason "latency spike, kvcache evictions"`

ops-bot: rdctl: request accepted, starting routing change. expected convergence ~30s. changeset id=CHS-5216789012-1

sre_oncall: routing change converged at ~22s. watching p95/p99...

alex_chung: p99 dropped to ~1.1s, p95 ~0.85s now. trending back to baseline. great. :thumbsup:

jamie_lee: rolling back canary as planned: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/quant-canary -n inference` — rollback initiated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CREATED — INC-2026-521678 (latency spike, eu-west-1). severity=SEV3. assigned=sre_oncall. link to incident doc: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-521678

maria_gomez: we'll keep the incident open for an hour after stabilization. Leah, coordinate customer comms; Jamie, please capture canary test gaps and add to the postmortem.

leah_h: on it — pinging affected customers with brief statement and ETA, will include workaround note (we routed traffic off impacted pool). :email:

sre_oncall: documenting timeline and actions in INC doc, tagging repo runbooks. will close paging in 15m if no recurrence.

alex_chung: added trace snippet for correlation: `trace_id=abc123, model=redwood-7b-quant-sparse-v2, observed_lat=4.2s, pool=dedicated-pool-5`

jamie_lee: filing follow-up ticket for canary criteria improvement — need kvcache eviction checks in smoke tests.

maria_gomez: thanks all. quick retrospective after incident postmortem.
